{{Infobox character|name=Aldous Blackcrest|epithet=Chronicler|image=Portrait aldous.jpg|house=[[House Blackcrest]]|role=Head of house; keeper of the Permanent Book|age=~61|kin=[[Vaela Blackcrest]] (daughter)|words=He who writes, remembers.|seat=[[Crown-watch]]}}
'''Chronicler Aldous Blackcrest''' is the realm's chief historian and keeper of the [[Chronicle of Victory|Permanent Book]] — the most refined and, some say, loneliest man in [[the Banner-lands]].

He speaks in polished, complete sentences, never a hesitation; and those who have pressed him on the thin years of the record report that he answers, with perfect elegance, a question you didn't ask. The closer to the old questions, the more beautiful the deflection.
